description: Climate Projections for South Australia is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. This is a sub-set of data released for GovHack 2017. The dataset includes simulations of daily weather variables for a small selection of weather stations (Adelaide, Coober Pedy, Mount Gambier, Port Pirie, Renmark) for historic and future (projected) climate conditions. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are climate change, environment. It offers 9 resource(s) in csv, pdf, shp, zip. The portal shows 2017-07-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
